# CommonJS compatibility package

The decoder algorithm is unchanged from upstream decode-uri-component 0.5.0, which fixes GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr. Only `export default` is converted to `module.exports` for legacy query-string consumers.

Upstream: https://github.com/SamVerschueren/decode-uri-component
